title: Trump invites teen lifeguard Ryder Williams to White House after heroic beach rescue
summary_full: President Donald Trump has invited 16-year-old California lifeguard Ryder Williams and his family to the White House after the teenager rescued a young boy from powerful waves at Seabright State Beach. Trump said Williams deserves a high civilian honour for his bravery. The dramatic rescue, captured on video, has drawn widespread praise from officials, witnesses and social media users, with many calling the rookie lifeguard true hero
